title: Autotune crash on dev 3.3
body:
Very strange, seems to be a regression between dev 3.2.0.1 and dev 3.3.0
Got crash only on my loop phone (not on dev phone)
Last successfull of Autotune was 4 days ago (24th dec), with dev 3.2.0.1, I updated 2 days ago to dev 3.3.0, and Autotune crash whatever number of selected days, on data load of the first selected day. (so even with the same data in database, now it crash when previously not)..
